name: smb-automated-recon-tool
description: SMB Automated Recon Tool - Complete SMB discovery and access validation

scripts.dev: node clean-ports.js && node check-prerequisites.js && concurrently "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.start: node check-prerequisites.js && npm run build && cd backend && npm start
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install
scripts.setup: chmod +x start.sh start-sudo.sh setup-sudo.sh check-privileges.sh check-prerequisites.js && npm run install:all
